correctness.rationale: Read RESULT.md from frozen Git tree. On [0,1/2) the first g branch contracts geometrically to 1/2, while J=[1/2,1] is a full slope ±2 tent with mixing normalized Lebesgue. F_n^n=g×⋯×g; each a.e. low/high word s has low coordinates tending to c=1/2 and k high coordinates generic for k-product tent measure, with n interleaved phases. Distinct rotating words yield μ_[s] average of product δ_c or λ over necklace; a.e. basin is union d(s) open cells of volume 2^-n, so exact mass d/2^n; ergodicity follows cyclic mixing components, entropy k/n log2 by power/product formulas. Burnside enumerates total and k-specific binary necklaces. Any periodic point must be in J^n; F_n restricted there has exactly two inverse branches, and each length-m inverse word composition has contracting n-th power with ratio≤2^-m, hence one fixed point. Critical tent preimages cannot yield distinct periodic symbolic duplicates since critical 3/4 goes to 1 then c; #Fix=2^m for any n,m. Uniform random inverse-branch contractions yield unique stationary λ^⊗n and weak equidistribution; h_top F_n=log2 and this is unique MME. Independent exact Burnside enumeration n=2..8 confirms necklace counts, not an all-n proof.
